scopes.description: Allows reading applications.
Allows creating or modifying applications.
Allows deleting applications.
Allows managing the scope vocabulary an application exposes.
Allows reading application scope definitions.
Allows creating or modifying application scope definitions.
Allows deleting application scope definitions.
Allows managing user assignments on applications.
Allows reading application user assignments.
Allows creating or modifying application user assignments.
Allows deleting application user assignments.
Allows managing scope assignments on application users.
Allows reading application user ACLs.
Allows creating or modifying application user ACLs.
Allows deleting application user ACLs.
Allows access to per-application signing keys.
Allows reading the public key and JWKS metadata.
Allows viewing the private key PEM. Holders of this scope can sign tokens on behalf of the application — keep strictly limited.
Allows issuing and revoking the machine-auth api id + secret credentials an application uses to call /a/... endpoints.
Allows listing an application's api credentials (never shows the plaintext secret, which is only returned once at create time).
Allows managing the per-application registration schema (steps + fields) served publicly at /a/{org}/{ws}/{app}/registration-fields.
Allows reading the saved registration schema for an application.
Manages the per-application login page template, background, logo, titles, and text block.
Allows reading the login-template settings and uploaded assets.

Allows changing the layout, background, logo, titles, and text block. Does not by itself grant changing allow_recovery or allow_registration — see the dedicated recovery_toggle/registration_toggle scopes.
Allows enabling or disabling password recovery for this application, without granting broader applications:write access (renaming, deactivating, reassigning the app).
Allows enabling or disabling self-registration (and its type) for this application, without granting broader applications:write access.
Per-application analytics on the Detail panel. Fine-grained per widget; the :read scope grants access to all widgets.
Allows viewing ALL analytics widgets on an application's Detail panel.
Allows viewing the application's user-access count widget.
Allows viewing the application's group-access count widget.
Allows viewing the application's active-scopes count widget.
Allows viewing the application's recent ACL grants widget.
Allows viewing the application's pending password-recovery count widget.
Allows managing external IdP OAuth provider configuration (Google, GitHub, Microsoft) for an application's login page.
Allows reading an application's configured OAuth providers.
Allows viewing an application's end-user login attempt history and its rotated-out archives.
Allows viewing application end-user login attempts (success and failure) and their archives.
